{"findings":[{"key":"f1","statement":"`.editorconfig` sets `end_of_line = lf`, `insert_final_newline = true`, `trim_trailing_whitespace = true` and `charset = utf-8` for every file, and 2-space indentation for `*.js`, `package.json` and `*.yml` files; it has no section naming `*.ts`.","mode":"descriptive","scope":{"kind":"paths","paths":[".editorconfig"]},"citations":[{"item":"E-2","lines":"3-7","quote":"[*]

indent_size = 2"}],"uncertainty":"Indentation for `.ts` files may be governed by Prettier defaults rather than `.editorconfig`."},{"key":"f2","statement":"`test/index.test.ts` starts a local `H3` app with routes such as `/ok` and `/post`, serves it via `serve(app, { port: 0, hostname: "localhost" })`, spies on `globalThis.fetch`, and asserts with chai-style `expect(...).to.equal`.","mode":"descriptive","scope":{"kind":"paths","paths":["test/index.test.ts"]},"citations":[{"item":"T5-001","lines":"19-22","quote":"const fetch = vi.spyOn(globalThis, "fetch");"},{"item":"T5-001","lines":"67-67","quote":"listener = await serve(app, { port: 0, hostname: "localhost" }).ready();"},{"item":"E-1","lines":"74-80","quote":"expect(await $fetch(getURL("ok"))).to.equal("ok");"}]},{"key":"f3","statement":"README documents proxy support in Node.js via the `dispatcher` option with undici's `ProxyAgent`, and `src/types.ts` types `dispatcher` from `undici`, which is a devDependency.","mode":"descriptive","scope":{"kind":"paths","paths":["README.md","src/types.ts"]},"citations":[{"item":"E-3","lines":"316-323","quote":"In Node.js (>= 18), you can use the `dispatcher` option with [undici](https://undici.nodejs.org/)'s `ProxyAgent`."},{"item":"T5-006","lines":"49-54","quote":"dispatcher?: InstanceType<typeof import("undici").Dispatcher>;"},{"item":"T3-001","lines":"35-35","quote":""undici": "^7.16.0","}]}],"gaps":[],"absenceClaims":[],"conflicts":[],"revisions":[{"target":"F-21","action":"withdraw","reason":"`.editorconfig` has now been read (E-2); its whitespace and indentation settings are recorded in a new finding."}],"contentNotices":[]}
